name: Rasko Sweet Scent
description: Offline-first business system: a Tauri app with an on-device SQLite replica that syncs to Supabase, plus edge functions for email and M-Pesa payouts

nodes.label: Rasko app
nodes.notes: Windows + Android. apps/app (entry src/main.tsx, Rust shell src-tauri/src/lib.rs). CSP allows only *.supabase.co and GitHub.

nodes.label: Website
nodes.notes: Marketing site + /reset-password. apps/website. Hosting on Vercel is inferred from .github/workflows/indexnow.yml.

nodes.label: Repositories
nodes.notes: Repository<T> + feature repositories; never touch the network. apps/app/src/data/repositories/repository.ts, src/features/*/*Repository.ts

nodes.label: Device SQLite
nodes.notes: sqlite:rasko.db mirrors server tables plus sync_state cursors. apps/app/src/data/sqlite/tauriDatabase.ts, schema.ts, tables.ts

nodes.label: Outbox
nodes.notes: Ordered write journal, written in the same transaction as the row; rejects go to outbox_dead. apps/app/src/data/sync/outbox.ts

nodes.label: Sync engine
nodes.notes: Push then pull, keyset cursors. Triggers: launch, write (2 s debounce), every 5 min, online event, manual. apps/app/src/data/sync/engine.ts, scheduler.ts

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.notes: Password sign-in, reset, admin API; Send Email hook to send-auth-email. supabase/config.toml, apps/app/src/auth/supabaseGateway.ts

nodes.label: PostgREST
nodes.notes: upsert/select with RLS, rpc('server_instance_id'). apps/app/src/data/sync/supabaseRemote.ts

nodes.label: Postgres
nodes.notes: 30 public tables, app.* triggers (invoice numbering, email + payout dispatch), views. supabase/migrations/*.sql

nodes.label: pg_cron sweeps
nodes.notes: Every minute: sweep-outbound-emails, sweep-payroll-payouts (retry, unstick, fail after 5 attempts). supabase/migrations/20260925000100_email.sql, 20260927000100_mpesa_b2c.sql

nodes.label: send-email
nodes.notes: Composes invoice emails from templates and settings, delivers with SMTP failover. supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts

nodes.label: send-auth-email
nodes.notes: Auth Send Email hook. supabase/functions/send-auth-email/index.ts

nodes.label: User admin functions
nodes.notes: invite-user, delete-user, set-user-active, assign-company-email, payout-wallet. supabase/functions/*

nodes.label: mpesa-b2c
nodes.notes: Salary payout dispatcher; PAYOUT_PROVIDER daraja (default) or intasend. supabase/functions/mpesa-b2c/index.ts

nodes.label: payout-result
nodes.notes: Provider callback, token in path; settles payroll_payouts. supabase/functions/payout-result/index.ts

nodes.label: Nightly backup
nodes.notes: cron 30 1 * * *: pg_dump, verify 12 core tables, upload, record backup_runs, issue on failure. .github/workflows/backup.yml

nodes.label: Release
nodes.notes: Tag v*: signed NSIS installer + latest.json (Windows only). .github/workflows/release.yml

nodes.label: SMTP providers
nodes.notes: Tried in EMAIL_PROVIDERS order with health tracking (email_provider_health). supabase/functions/_shared/email/transport.js

nodes.label: Cloudflare Email Routing
nodes.notes: Company mailbox forwarding. supabase/functions/_shared/mailbox/routing.js

nodes.label: Safaricom Daraja
nodes.notes: supabase/functions/_shared/mpesa/b2c.js

nodes.label: IntaSend
nodes.notes: supabase/functions/_shared/payouts/intasend.js

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.notes: daily/ kept 30 days, monthly/ kept 12 months. .github/workflows/backup.yml

nodes.label: GitHub Releases
nodes.notes: Updater endpoint in apps/app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json

steps.note: InvoicesScreen → useInvoices → InvoicesRepository.insert
Write the invoice row locally; the UI never waits on the network
enqueue('invoices', id, 'insert') in the same SQLite transaction
notifyLocalWrite starts a 2 s debounce
rpc server_instance_id: if the server DB was replaced, wipe the replica
Drain the outbox in batches of 200
upsert onConflict id
RLS applies; app.assign_invoice_number sets the number
Pull: keyset pages of 500 from the sync_state cursor
Apply rows and advance the cursor in one transaction; the invoice number arrives
SendEmailDialog → EmailRepository
outbound_emails row, status queued
Push is insert-only for outbound_emails
force_outbound_email_defaults trigger
AFTER INSERT outbound_emails_dispatch → net.http_post({ id })
Read the invoice, items, settings and template with the service role
Brevo → Resend → Gmail failover; email_provider_health is recorded
If delivery failed: retried every minute, up to 5 attempts
Next pull brings sent/failed back to EmailActivity
resetPasswordForEmail, redirect to the website /reset-password
Standard Webhooks signature checked
Branded email through the SMTP failover
SetPasswordForm: verifyOtp, then updateUser
PayMpesaDialog → mpesaPayouts
payroll_payouts row, status queued
Push the payout row
prepare_payroll_payout trigger
dispatch_new_payout via pg_net
B2C request (or IntaSend when PAYOUT_PROVIDER=intasend)
Provider calls back with the result
settle_payroll_payout; the payslip is marked paid
The result is pulled back to the device
04:30 Nairobi: pg_dump --format=custom through the session pooler; verify 12 core tables
daily/ copy (monthly/ on the 1st); prune old copies
insert into backup_runs; it syncs down to the System screen
Tag v* → signed NSIS installer + latest.json
On launch: check, downloadAndInstall, relaunch (Windows only)
